## Summary

Describe the research, canonical-data, app, or deployment change.

## Knowledge files

- [ ] Evidence record added or updated
- [ ] Canonical JSON added or versioned
- [ ] `MASTER_INDEX.json` updated
- [ ] `PROJECT_STATUS.md` updated
- [ ] `CURRENT_WORK.md` updated
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated

## App integration

- [ ] Trait registered in `src/knowledge/index.ts`, or not applicable
- [ ] API response checked, or not applicable
- [ ] Gemini grounding checked, or not applicable
- [ ] Canonical Knowledge UI checked, or not applicable

## Research safety

- [ ] Tradition-level claims are separated from scientific evidence
- [ ] Conditional traits remain conditional
- [ ] Unsupported and clinical claims are excluded
- [ ] Trait boundaries and duplicate claims were reviewed
- [ ] No trait ID, phase number, or canonical wording was guessed

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant tests or API smoke checks
- [ ] Render live deployment verified after merge

## Continuity

State the exact next phase/action so a new chat can continue from GitHub without relying on chat history.
